_comment: These rows are NOT created here. CodeGen creates one Entity row per table, so every entity this
directory targets already exists by the time it is pushed; what this directory does is fill in ONE
column -- `Configuration`, the JSON that carries form chrome (layout, related-grid policy).
autoCreateMissingRecords is FALSE, deliberately, for the same reason entity-relationships sets it:
every record resolves its primary key with @lookup by NAME, because the CodeGen row is re-minted
with a new ID on every rebuild-db. If a lookup fails to resolve, the correct outcome is a LOUD
FAILURE -- with auto-create on, the push would insert a second, half-populated Entity row beside
CodeGen's and quietly break the next codegen run.
